# Bisendra Melaram

> Bisendra Melaram, Licensed Real Estate Salesperson with Keller Williams Greater Nassau in Garden City, NY, licensed since 2003 and holder of the SRES designation. He helps buyers and sellers across Long Island, with a focus on the South Shore of Nassau County (Valley Stream, Lynbrook, Rockville Centre, Oceanside, Baldwin, Freeport), sellers 50 and older, and South Asian families.

Office: Keller Williams Greater Nassau, 400 Garden City Plaza, Suite 438, Garden City, NY 11530. Phone 516-873-7100.

## Services
- [Buyers](https://bisendramelaram.com/buyers/): buying on the South Shore, flood zones, buyer agreements
- [Sellers](https://bisendramelaram.com/sellers/): pricing and New York's 2024 disclosure rules
- [Seniors and downsizing](https://bisendramelaram.com/seniors-downsizing/): SRES help for clients 50+
- [South Asian families](https://bisendramelaram.com/south-asian-buyers/): gift funds, multigenerational homes
- [Areas served](https://bisendramelaram.com/areas/)
